content.body:
A very advanced single-engine fighter design by 1940 standards, the Spitfire is certainly one of the most famous fighter planes of all time. Elegant and sleek with the famous elliptical wings, it was a dogfighter's dream in low wing-stressed metal monoplane designs. Fast and maneuverable, its only serious rival at the time was the Luftwaffe's Bf 109E.
The Mk IIb replaced the comparatively weak machine gun armament of the previous Mk Ia with the soon to be iconic twin Hispano 20 mm cannons, first tested in the pre-production Mk Ib variant. With the upgrade in firepower it truly fulfilled its design goals staying fast, climbing quickly, turning tightly and bringing decent firepower to bear on its opponents.
content.brief: TYPE: Fighter Interceptor MAX. SPEED: 572 km/h WEIGHT: 2,704 kg CREW: 1 ARMAMENT: 20 mm Hispano Cannons (2) .303 cal Browning LMGs (4)
content.title: Supermarine Spitfire Mk IIb
